summary: Enter trusted proxies in Proxy IP Allowed List (for example `["example1.proxy.com:8080", "example2.proxy.com:8080"]`); they must sanitize and set `X-Forwarded-For` correctly. Only use `HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR` with SSL termination, a validating proxy and `PROXY_IP_ALLOWED_LIST` in `/etc/tower/conf.d/remote_host_headers.py` limited to trusted proxies.
questions: How do I configure known proxies in automation controller?
When is it safe to use HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR in controller?

answer_card.title: Configure known proxies
answer_card.answer_md:
**Settings > Automation Execution > System**, Proxy IP Allowed List:
```json
[
  "example1.proxy.com:8080",
  "example2.proxy.com:8080"
]
```
Only add `HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR` to Remote Host Headers if TLS is terminated at the proxy, the proxy sanitizes `X-Forwarded-For`, and `PROXY_IP_ALLOWED_LIST` (`/etc/tower/conf.d/remote_host_headers.py`) lists only trusted proxies.
